{{Top|leg}}
'''Karfs''' were delicate, arboreal creatures that lived in the [[tisvollt]] forests of [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]]. They were a minority of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Brolf]] inhabitants, and were also smaller.
